title: Perfect size, extremely fragile
text: Perfect size, extremely fragile. This lasted thru 5 uses. I used it to make cakes. It withstood my mixer just fine, but then it cracked by washing  in the bottom rack of the dishwasher. If you want a long lasting product invest the extra few bucks and buy glass.
